card.name: Inspecting and disposing of product
card.fires_on: Words inside handling instructions about looking over a product for damage or particles, or disposing of unused product. It fires on words like look, visually, for, product, or and with in those phrases.

modes.label: Visual inspection
modes.description: Words in instructions to inspect a solution or tablet for particles, discoloration or damage.
modes.example: Inspect Renacidin<< visually>> for particulate matter and discoloration

modes.label: Disposal of unused product
modes.description: Words in the phrase about discarding unused medicinal product according to local requirements.
modes.example: Dispose of any unused medicinal<< product>> or waste material in accordance with local requirements
